colleges.songTitle: Let’s Not Shit Ourselves (To Love and to Be Loved)
colleges.line: Now, a mother takes loans out, sends her kids off to colleges
stanza: Now, a mother takes loans out, sends her kids off to colleges
Her family's reduced to names on a shopping list
While a coroner kneels beneath a great, wooden crucifix
He knows there's worse things than being alone
And so I've learned to retreat at the first sign of danger
I mean, why wait around if it's just to surrender?
And ambition, I've found, can lead only to failure
I do not read the reviews
No, I am not singing for you
